verbs.name: transcript.remove_silences
verbs.description: Remove detected silences. Timeline-wide by default; optional asset/track narrows scope. aggressiveness is REQUIRED — named presets: calm = long pauses only, natural = default feel, jumpy = tight cut. ONE op per removed span (skim-reviewable).

min_ms.description: Only remove silences at least this long; preset default

padding_ms.description: Breathing room kept on each side; preset default

asset.description: Narrow to clips of this asset

track.description: Narrow DETECTION to spans present on this track; the cut itself still ripples all tracks (AV sync)

allow_extreme.description: Totality guard override: without it the verb REFUSES (code guardrail) when the pass would remove >80% of the timeline — near-total removal usually means silent-by-design footage, not a wanted cut

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {spans_removed: n, total_removed_ms, op_ids} — one op per span

verbs.name: transcript.remove_fillers
verbs.description: Cut filler words (default lexicon 'um','uh','erm','ah','hmm','mhm'). Timeline-wide by default; optional asset/track narrows scope. ONE op per removed run. Custom lexicon overrides the default English filler list; entries are lowercased and stripped to alphanumeric characters using the same normalization as transcript words.

lexicon.description: Filler words to target; default English list. Entries are normalized like transcript words, so 'uh-huh' matches a word token rendered as 'uh-huh'/'uhhuh'.

asset.description: Narrow to clips of this asset

track.description: Narrow DETECTION to spans present on this track; the cut itself still ripples all tracks (AV sync)

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {fillers_removed: n, total_removed_ms, op_ids} — one op per filler run

verbs.name: transcript.remove_retakes
verbs.description: Auto-remove repeated line ATTEMPTS (retakes / do-overs) from a talking-head transcript, KEEPING the best take. Segments the transcript into utterances (sentence punctuation OR a pause gap > pause_ms), detects runs of consecutive near-identical utterances by token-sequence similarity (normalized Levenshtein ≥ similarity), keeps ONE per run (keep: last=good final take | first | longest) and ripple-cuts the rest — reusing transcript.remove_fillers' cut path (the cut ripples all tracks for AV sync). Timeline-wide by default; optional asset/track narrows scope. min_words ignores 1-2 word utterances. No transcribed asset in scope → actionable transcribe-first error; no retakes found → ok with removed_takes:0 (clean no-op).

asset.description: Narrow to clips of this asset

track.description: Narrow DETECTION to spans present on this track; the cut itself still ripples all tracks (AV sync)

similarity.description: Min token-sequence similarity (normalized Levenshtein) for two utterances to count as the same line. Default 0.6.

pause_ms.description: Pause gap (ms) between consecutive words that ends an utterance. Default 600.

keep.description: Which take to keep from a run of attempts: last (default — the good final take) | first | longest (most content words).

min_words.description: Ignore utterances with fewer content tokens (never a retake). Default 3.

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {removed_takes, kept, keep_policy, words_removed, ms_removed, clusters:[{asset, kept:{word_range,at_ms,text}, removed:[{word_range,at_ms,text}]}], op_ids} — one ripple op per removed-take timeline span

verbs.name: transcript.translate
verbs.description: Translate an asset's word-level transcript into target_lang (TEXT only -- no dubbing/audio/TTS), writing a SIBLING transcript artifact receipts/<asset>.<lang>.words.json (the SOURCE transcript is left untouched). BACKEND: PRIMARY = the user's OWN subscription CLI agent (claude/codex/grok -- the SAME CLI agent.chat uses; pure text in/out, NO MCP/tools), the best-quality path (idioms, names, context); FALLBACK = a LOCAL self-hosted model (Opus-MT light per-pair, or MADLAD-400 universal via model) run by translate_runner.py in the perception venv (the model DOWNLOADS on first use -- not bundled). backend:auto (default)=CLI if available else local; cli/local force one. The translator works at SENTENCE-ISH SEGMENT grain (better quality than per-word); segment-level timing is EXACT, and per-word timing within a segment is LINEARLY INTERPOLATED (honest limit: true per-word timing needs forced alignment on the translated text, out of scope). Read-only w.r.t. the op-log (writes to receipts/, the evidence store, like media.transcribe). asset is optional when exactly one asset has a transcript. Feeds export/search/captions in the target language.

asset.description: Asset whose transcript to translate. Optional when exactly one asset has a transcript.

target_lang.description: Language to translate INTO (e.g. "es", "lv", "Latvian"). For the LOCAL backend a 2-letter code is required.

source_lang.description: Source language. Optional for the CLI backend (the LLM auto-detects); REQUIRED for the local Opus-MT backend (per-pair). Defaults to the transcript's detected language when present.

backend.description: auto (default) = CLI if available else local; cli/local force one.

model.description: Override the model: a CLI model name (e.g. a claude model) or a local HF id (e.g. a MADLAD-400 build). Default local = Opus-MT for the pair.

timeout_ms.description: Spawn timeout. CLI default 180000 (clamp 10000..600000); local default 1800000 (first run downloads the model).

verbs.result: {asset, source_lang, target_lang, backend, backend_proven, model, agent, segments_translated, words, transcript, word_timing:"interpolated", note} -- transcript is the relative path of the written receipts/<asset>.<lang>.words.json. No op appended (artifact under receipts/).
